full_name: Xiaoxiao Zhao | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Xiaoxiao Zhao is an architect and artist who perceives design as a medium for revealing human behaviors on planetary conditions, focusing on environmental technologies, climate-related media studies, and weather-responsive systems. At Radcliffe, she will create an immersive audiovisual experience to investigate and convey the environmental and socio-spatial impacts of data centers.
